headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to support US biotechnology and biomanufacturing, with attention to safety and security.
what_it_does: This executive order sets a federal policy to grow the American bioeconomy, meaning products and industries built on biotechnology and biomanufacturing. It directs federal agencies to take steps to advance innovation in these fields. The title also stresses goals of sustainability, safety, and security. No summary was provided, so the specific actions, programs, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies are directed to carry out policies that support biotechnology and biomanufacturing.
Their industry is the focus of the federal policy, though the specific effects on them are not stated in the available information.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 12, 2022; executive orders generally take effect when signed.
